query: SELECT ms.id, ms.name, ms.shortName, ms.slug, ms.totalCards, COUNT(mc.id) as actual_cards FROM marvel_sets ms LEFT JOIN marvel_cards mc ON mc.setId = ms.id GROUP BY ms.id, ms.name, ms.shortName, ms.slug, ms.totalCards ORDER BY ms.id;
